business_overview.one_sentence: The Group researches, manufactures and sells rail fastening system products, welding wire products and railway sleeper products in the PRC.

business_overview.revenue_model: Product sales to railway, shipbuilding and trading customers; other operating revenue includes raw materials, product processing services and electricity sales.
business_notes: Rail fastening products contributed 61.8% of 2024 revenue and most segment gross profit.
Welding wire gross profit was approximately breakeven/negative in 2024 due to competition and lower selling prices.
Accounts receivable are large and recovery cycle lengthened, leading to higher expected credit loss.

gaps: Full 2024 annual report was not available from the directly accessible links during this run; the fact pack uses the 2024 annual results announcement.
Cash flow statement, operating cash flow, capital expenditure and financing cash flow were not present in the available source.
Monetary capital note was not available, so deposits, restricted cash, pledged deposits and other monetary funds could not be separated.
Borrowing maturity, collateral and pledged deposit details were not available beyond the balance sheet and MD&A summary.
Only 2023 and 2024 comparative profit figures were available; a full three-year median could not be calculated from the available source.
